spacingPolicy.explanation: The requested target of two long-form videos plus one Short every seven days is mathematically incompatible with a 72-hour minimum: three cyclic gaps require at least 216 hours. The current Tuesday/Saturday two-slot draft schedule satisfies 96-hour and 72-hour gaps as an interim safety fallback; it does not replace the requested target or authorize publication.
